thread:
Carmen: Ops asked to enable autoswitch fallback for rollout-v2. tiny UX/telemetry sync so we don't drown SOC in audit rows.
Theo: Two main asks: (1) make overrides low-friction, (2) keep full audit for any persistent operator action.
Rina: Suggestion: sampled decision rows + full audit only for `stick` overrides or manual replay requests. Sampling should be heavier at start.
Owen: Agreed. Concrete sampling: first 10 minutes at 20%, then exponential decay to 0.5% over 8 hours. capture noisy startup.
Carmen: UI: show a compact "fallback status" pill on rollout card: e.g. `soft-fallback  latency_p95  2.4%`. clicking opens a small digest with top reasons and one sampled trace.
Theo: We need standardized reason strings. proposal: latency_p95, upstream_5xx, quota_exhaust, model_infer_err, cold_start. No numeric codes.
Rina: Good. Also add `degrade_mode` enum: trial, soft, hard. show both in pill.
Owen: Operator tools: quick snooze (5m/30m/2h) on the card (no note), `stick` in operator panel with required short note. `stick` must create an immutable audit row.
Carmen: Protect against flip-flopping: cooldown for consecutive sticks per-rollout: 0m -> 10m -> 1h -> 6h. record cooldown level in audit.
Theo: Telemetry schema fields to require on decision event: decision_id, rollout_id, ts, fallback_reason, degrade_mode, sampled (true/false), override_action, override_actor, override_note, override_ttl, policy_rev, prev_route_id, fallback_variant_id.
Rina: For the digest view include: counts, top-3 reasons, sampled example with a one-line "why" (e.g. "latency_p95 920ms > 800ms"). full audit list should be behind a pagination view so it's not huge.
Owen: For operators, quicksearch query to include in docs: `events | where rollout_id=="<id>" and decision=="fallback" | summarize count() by fallback_reason, override_action`
stash-bot: Deploy note: rollout-v2-autoswitch scheduled by @Carmen at 1767770150. Monitoring channels auto-subscribed.
Carmen: Action items: Theo publish reason/degrade enum and schema diff; Rina mock pill + digest in Figma; Owen add cooldown enforcement and audit wiring; I'll hold flip until we have mocks.
Theo: I'll post schema PR this afternoon with migration plan.
Rina: Figma card + digest mock by EOD.
Owen: Infra ticket for cooldown & retention opened.
Carmen: If mocks look good we flip tomorrow. if not, we delay. objections?
Rina: none.
Theo: none.
Owen: all good.
Carmen: thanks all :thumbsup:
